title: GenVoid: Uncertainty-Aware Learning of Subsurface Material Defects with an Experimentally Validated Physics-Informed Generative Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.23761v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Internal voids are ubiquitous defects in manufactured structures, yet their characterization remains challenging because their geometry is hidden and can only be inferred indirectly from accessible measurements. Here we introduce \textit{GenVoid}, a physics-informed generative model-based framework for identifying internal voids in complex two- and three-dimensional solids from surface displacement measurements alone. By incorporating the governing mechanics into a generative inference framework, \textit{GenVoid} enables void identification across linear elastic, hyperelastic and plastic material behaviours and accommodates complex two- and three-dimensional structural geometries. Importantly, the framework explicitly accounts for uncertainty and noise in displacement measurements, producing probabilistic reconstructions of internal void geometry rather than a single deterministic estimate. We demonstrate the approach using high-fidelity

translated_title: GenVoid：基于经实验验证的物理信息生成模型的亚表面材料缺陷不确定性感知学习
translated_abstract: 内部空隙是制造结构中普遍存在的缺陷，但由于其几何形状是隐藏的，只能通过可获取的测量进行间接推断，因此对其表征仍然极具挑战性。本文提出了GenVoid，这是一个基于物理信息生成模型的框架，仅利用表面位移测量即可识别复杂二维和三维固体中的内部空隙。通过将主导力学方程融入生成式推理框架，GenVoid能够在线性弹性、超弹性和塑性等多种材料行为下实现空隙识别，并适用于复杂的二维和三维结构几何形状。重要的是，该框架显式地考虑了位移测量中的不确定性和噪声，能够生成内部空隙几何形状的概率性重建，而非单一的确定性估计。我们使用高保真（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了GenVoid框架，将力学控制方程融入生成式模型，仅凭表面位移测量即可在不确定性和噪声条件下，对复杂二维和三维固体中的内部空隙进行跨弹性、超弹性和塑性材料行为的概率化识别与重建。
en_tdlr: GenVoid is a physics-informed generative framework that identifies internal voids in complex 2D and 3D solids from surface displacement measurements alone, producing uncertainty-aware probabilistic reconstructions across linear elastic, hyperelastic, and plastic material behaviors.
